description: Read every top-level comment on a public post from its link, with no account: YouTube videos. Returns the post (title, the account that posted it) and each comment's handle, text and time, ready for draw_winners or a comment picker. An Instagram post needs its owner: the answer is a link for them to pick a verifiable winner from that post.

link.description: The post's link, as copied from its share button: a YouTube video.

name: read_post_comments
title: Read a post's comments from its link
